title: unterminated quoted scalar
notes: Fixed (spec docs/error-reporting/specs/E-BOUNDARY.md). Read the 15 narrowly: it is available because PyYAML computed both marks and kept the whole program in `mark.buffer`, and it is not the class average -- the generic branch of the same recognizer scores 12. The second caret is moved from `context_mark` to the unpaired quote by the one heuristic in the design (odd count of `"` or `'` after masking escapes, scanning from the context line to the problem line); when it does not fire the diagnostic degrades to the generic branch rather than guessing. No block path, because a document that did not parse has no blocks.
